# SpotlightTodAI

> A curated archive of Oral & Spotlight papers (the top ~1-5% of accepted
> papers) from NeurIPS / ICLR / ICML. 1167 papers. Serverless static JSON API —
> just GET a URL, no auth, no rate limits.

Base URL for the API: https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api

## API

- [papers.json](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api/papers.json): Full archive. Each paper has a stable `uid` (`<conf>-<year>-<track>-<id>`), conference, year, track, title, authors, affiliation, summary, links{openreview,arxiv,detail}.
- [daily.json](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api/daily.json): Deterministic "paper of the day" + upcoming candidates. Reproducible from the date (KST); rotates through the whole archive without repeats. Refreshed each morning by a GitHub Actions cron.
- [venues.json](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api/venues.json): Conference/year/track catalogue with counts.
- [topics.json](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api/topics.json): Curated keyword -> paper-uid inverted index (substring match over title+summary).

Every file carries a `schema_version` (currently 1). Join across files on `uid`.

## Docs

- [API README](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai/api/README.md): Full endpoint docs, schemas, and curl examples.

## Tools

- [MCP server](https://github.com/dion-jy/spotlight-todai/tree/main/mcp): 3 tools — search_papers, daily_feed, recommend — wrapping the JSON API. Stdlib-only fetch, minimal deps.

## Optional

- [Website](https://dion-jy.github.io/spotlight-todai): Human-facing searchable/filterable table of all papers.
- [Source repo](https://github.com/dion-jy/spotlight-todai): data.json + build scripts.
